Third-party components used by graphican.online (Design tools and Editor)

u2netp.onnx — U^2-Net (U2NETP), Qin et al. — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net  (ONNX export: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg)
realesr/ — Real-ESRGAN (general-x4v3, wdn-x4v3), Xintao Wang et al. — BSD 3-Clause
  https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN
tf.min.js — TensorFlow.js — Apache License 2.0
pdf.min.mjs / pdf.worker.min.mjs — PDF.js, Mozilla — Apache License 2.0
pdf-lib.min.js — pdf-lib — MIT
fontkit.min.js — @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 — MIT
mammoth.min.js — mammoth.js 1.12.3 (DOCX reader) — BSD 2-Clause
xlsx.min.js — SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5 — Apache License 2.0
heic2any.min.js — heic2any 0.0.4 (HEIC/HEIF decoder) — MIT
utif.js — UTIF.js 3.1.0 (TIFF decoder), Photopea — MIT
pako-inflate.min.js — pako 1.0.11 — MIT / Zlib
paper-core.min.js — Paper.js 0.12.18 (boolean path operations in the Editor) — MIT

Loaded from jsDelivr at runtime:
  Fabric.js 5.3.0 — MIT — https://github.com/fabricjs/fabric.js
